headline:
Cheap on PE,
pricey on growth
chart_note: 52-week range: $289.10 - $426.75. Currently around $319, about 22% up from the low but still roughly 25% below the high.
why_today: Down about 25% from its 52-week high - a PE of 22.5x looks reasonable on the surface, but the PEG ratio tells a pricier story once growth is factored in.
pro_1: Quarterly revenue grew 5.7% YoY, and the 2.9% dividend yield is one of the highest among mega-cap retailers
pro_2: Moderate Buy consensus from 28 analysts, with the stock well off its highs after a rough stretch
con_1: PEG ratio of about 5.4x is unusually rich - investors are still paying a premium relative to the actual growth rate
con_2: Down sharply from its 52-week high, reflecting real concerns about slowing consumer spending on home improvement
